newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Elec & Eltrek plans $32 mn placement.
newsitem.headline: Elec & Eltrek plans $32 mn placement.

text.p: The parent company of Elec & Eltrek International Company Limited (E&EI) has agreed to place 11 million shares to international investors at US$2.92 a share, its directors said in a statement received on Saturday.

The statement said the printed circuit board manufacturer's parent company, Elec & Eltrek International Holdings Limited (E&EIH) shareholding will be cut from 76.07 per cent to 65.39 percent after the placement.
E&EIH, a company incorporated in Bermuda and listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange, plans to use the proceeds from the placement as general working capital, it said.
The parent company said the placement will broaden E&EI's shareholder base and enhance the liquidity of the firm's shares.
The placement shares represent about 10.68 percent of the issued capital of E&EI.
The price of the placement shares represents a discount of 5.2 percent based on its last traded price of $3.08 on October 17.
